payload.reason: The evidence provides a detailed explanation of how the BERT-based model works for query-focused summarization, including input processing, scoring mechanisms, and sentence selection.

claims.text: The BERT-based model encodes query relevance and document context into vector representations using BERT, which are then used to predict sentence labels or scores.
The model takes the concatenation of the query and document as input and uses a self-attention mechanism to jointly model query-sentence and sentence-sentence relationships.
The input representation for each token is constructed using token, segmentation, and position embeddings, following standard BERT practices.
Sentences are selected for the summary based on their estimated scores, with redundancy constraints applied to minimize overlap.
